chunks: Those who accuse their wives and do not have any witnesses except themselves, should swear four times in the name of God, the testimony of each such person being that he is speaking the truth,

key_terms.يَرْمُونَ: to accuse or strike with the eye (of adultery)

ai.seo_question: What is the procedure of Li'an when a husband accuses his wife of adultery without witnesses?
ai.summary: This verse establishes the foundational mechanism of *Li'an* (mutual imprecation) in Shia and Sunni jurisprudence, serving as a procedural alternative to the standard requirement of four witnesses for *Hadd* punishment in cases of adultery. It details the husband's obligation to swear four oaths affirming his truthfulness, followed by a fifth oath invoking divine curse upon himself if he is lying, thereby clearing him from the penalty of false accusation (*Qadhf*). This legal procedure highlights the balance between preserving lineage and ensuring judicial fairness when evidence is limited to the parties' testimonies.
